Document states TOTAL price for the full quantity, not unit price. Tests the exact unit-vs-total distinction flagged as a real-world gotcha during schema design. unit_price must stay null, not get computed by dividing.
Certificate explicitly available at an additional cost -- the exact scenario CertificateMention's status/additional_cost fields were built for, never tested with a real document before this.
Document never mentions certificates at all. Correct behavior is an empty list, not a hallucinated certificate.
Quoted quantity (5) and minimum order quantity (20) are different numbers in the same document. Tests that quantity and MOQ don't get confused with each other.
Genuinely incomplete document -- no price stated at all, just 'contact sales'. Correct behavior is null price fields, not a guessed number. The one deliberately hard case in this set.
